newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian avg money market rate slides to 8.6 pct.
newsitem.headline: Croatian avg money market rate slides to 8.6 pct.

text.p: The Croatian average money market rate slid to 8.6 percent on Thursday from 9.6 percent due to weaker interbank demand and high liquidity.
Daily trade totalled 25.4 million kuna ($3.9 million), leaving a surplus of 75 million on the supply side.
Fresh loans accounted for 23.4 million kuna, half of which were call money borrowings at a steady 7.0-0percent rate. A five million kuna one-day loan was granted at the same rate.
Rates for one-month interbank funds were cut to 11 and 12 percent, from the usual 13 percent.
Old one-month loans were rolled over at 12 and 15 percent.
The kuna midrates for Friday firmed slightly to 6.5330 against the dollar and to 3.5633 against the German mark. -- Zoran Radosavljevic, Zagreb newsroom +385 1 455 7075 ($ = 6.504 Croatian Kuna)
